_comment: Copy to .mcp.json. Used by Claude Code during development AND loaded by src/mcp/client.ts at runtime. JIRA = Atlassian Rovo MCP Server (official, remote). Local: OAuth 2.1 via mcp-remote (browser consent). Headless/CI: API token (org admin must enable) sent as an Authorization header - see Atlassian Rovo MCP docs for the current endpoint. Only tools listed in config/mcp-tools.yaml are loaded (allow-list). Optional: add an Azure DevOps MCP server here if you use ADO.
